issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method on Animal (UML '+' visibility), but the reference solution declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the intended accessibility of the method and whether they should declare it public or protected when implementing/overriding it.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the visibility of messageOnFeed() between specification and implementation. Either update the UML / problem statement to indicate protected visibility, or change the solution's Animal.java to declare the method public (public abstract String messageOnFeed()) so it matches the UML and the description.
